mutations.kill_message_redacted: a 'fitted_score' is not a marginal-likelihood ratio and may not be called a Bayes factor or evidence
mutations.kill_rule: a fitted score or max-likelihood ratio offered as a Bayes factor is rejected by the evidence-kind guard

mutations.kill_message_redacted: the prior is unnormalized — the evidence integral is only defined for a normalized prior density
mutations.kill_rule: an unnormalized prior is rejected by the prior-normalization guard

mutations.kill_message_redacted: a caller-supplied scalar is not an evidence receipt — a receipt binds the normalized prior, likelihood, data, and engine diagnostics
mutations.kill_rule: a caller-supplied scalar offered as a log evidence is rejected by the engine-receipt guard

mutations.kill_message_redacted: the two evidence engines share the same sample provenance — post-processing one sample set twice is not two engines
mutations.kill_rule: two engines with identical sample provenance are rejected by the independence guard

mutations.kill_message_redacted: the evidence is indeterminate (engine disagreement or insufficient diagnostics) and may not be reported as a coherent Bayes factor
mutations.kill_rule: reporting a coherent evidence claim when the engines disagree beyond tolerance is rejected by the disagreement policy

mutations.kill_message_redacted: the log Bayes factor swings 9.000 across the prior/covariance grid (> 4.0) — the result is prior-sensitive and the decisive claim is indeterminate
mutations.kill_rule: reporting a decisive Bayes factor when the prior-sensitivity swing exceeds the ceiling is rejected by the sensitivity gate
